municipality_model_role: Energy/resource score is supporting evidence only
project_level_evidence_required: Contracts or autoproduction covering 100% of contractual electricity demand from clean/renewable sources
decision_rule: Fail Redata-oriented project if not demonstrated

municipality_model_role: Climate and water context inform feasibility but cannot prove WUE
project_level_evidence_required: Engineering design and operating commitment demonstrating annual cooling WUE <= 0.05 L/kWh
decision_rule: Fail Redata-oriented project if design cannot demonstrate threshold

municipality_model_role: Grid-strength score + EPE/ONS risk evidence prioritise due diligence
project_level_evidence_required: Utility/ONS connection study, requested MW, delivery date, redundancy and firm-access evidence
decision_rule: Do not advance parcel as investment-grade without plausible connection pathway

municipality_model_role: CNUC municipal overlap is a screening flag, not parcel exclusion
project_level_evidence_required: Parcel coordinates overlaid with current CNUC and other applicable environmental/legal constraints; licensing pathway
decision_rule: Exclude parcels with irreconcilable legal/environmental conflict

municipality_model_role: ANA Q95 + basin pressure = context only
project_level_evidence_required: Source, right/permit, utility or reclaimed-water commitment, drought resilience, treatment and discharge strategy
decision_rule: Do not treat nearby water or Q95 as guaranteed industrial supply

gate: Carrier diversity and physical route redundancy
municipality_model_role: ANATEL provider diversity is screening evidence
project_level_evidence_required: Carrier quotes, physically independent routes, capacity/wavelengths, latency and SLA
decision_rule: Provider count alone does not satisfy hyperscale redundancy

project_level_evidence_required: Design-day extremes, heat-wave analysis, liquid-cooling architecture, redundancy and PUE/WUE trade-off
decision_rule: Municipality climate score cannot substitute for facility thermal design
